routes.when: Erect a new factory from available resources and owner preferences.
Register or provision a product inside an existing factory.
Resolve material ambiguity in factory, product, feature, or bug requirements.
routes.skipWhen: Accepted intent and testable criteria already resolve the decision; preserve explicit owner instructions to skip.

routes.when: Resolve a bounded factual question before making a design or implementation choice.
Turn intent or an issue into scoped parent-child work and dependency contracts.
Plan executable work against accepted intent, constraints, resources, and verification criteria.
Resolve interfaces, data behavior, UX, or architecture decisions needed by the work.
Implement an authorized work item in its owned workspace.
Independently assess an exact plan, design, or code revision against criteria.
Reproduce a bug or verify behavior, regression, security, and recovery outcomes.
Release an exact artifact to an authorized environment and observe health.
Diagnose and maintain a released product, including incidents and recovery.
Run /faktori-update to upgrade an existing factory and optionally connect its Manager Loop records.
Transfer evidence and approved scope across agents, providers, or interrupted sessions.
Operate, diagnose, or recover the factory itself within delegated authority.
Propose and verify a measured improvement to factory behavior or skills.
